transcript: here's a couple things that can help your ré stand out from an experienced recruiter who reads a ton of resumés one thing a lot of people go back and forth on is the idea of Bolding keywords some people think this is great some don't care it is unlikely that somebody will see this and not like it so if you're concerned people aren't seeing your keywords consider Bolding them this is actually a brand new feature we just rolled out a teal it gives you the option when you edit or add bullet points to underline bold them or hyperlink them all things that could make a difference in a crowded field I'm actually a huge fan of hyperlinks on a resume this is a great way to get people to go see the work you want them to see and now you can do it in Teal's Resume Builder a lot of youve been asking for it and now it's here let me know is this something that you like and can see yourself using it can be a way to stand out in a crowded field of resumes
